concerns.text: FR-001 mandates ingestion of public datasets from NIST, UCI, and OpenML. No task in tasks.md implements external repository acquisition; T002 only ingests bundled synthetic and verification CSV files. This leaves FR-001 partially unmet and violates the specification.

Constitution VII requires that a ≥10 % MAPE improvement be demonstrated **consistently across material classes** and that paired t‑tests be performed. The current task set (T006) runs a Wilcoxon test on the pooled measured‑stress set and does not include per‑material‑class MAPE comparisons nor paired t‑tests, so the constitutional requirement is not covered.
